今回は、エンジニアが目標と制約を言葉でClaude Opus 5.5に伝えました。
Claudeはモデルの構造と重みを調べて仮説を立て、プログラムを直すのと同じ要領で数値を書き換え、評価の結果を見て次の手を決めました。

そしてClaudeが改善した新しいモデルを、実際の利用者で約1週間試すと、このモデル経由の1人あたりの保存数が8.4〜10.7%増えました。

彼らはこれを「ウェイトコーディング」と呼ぶことにしました。

note_tweet.text:
I asked Claude to populate a Civilization-style game map with real data from the US. Opus 5.5 downloaded and parse a ton of public data and 7 hours and 45K lines of code later... it works :)

- 31 real data sources including Census, BEA, BLS, EIA, NOAA, USGS, DoD, NPS, FAA, FEMA, CDC...
- Real elevation, land cover, GDP, jobs, power plants, mines, ports, airports, bases, parks, universities, freight flows, disasters; all reconciled onto one 25 km hex grid.
- The data is converted into Civilization language, e.g. Gold yield is GDP. A city's districts are its real industry specializations: San Jose gets a Campus, Detroit is "Motor city". Its citizens are its real workforce: 1 in 4 San Jose workers are engineers, coders or scientists, against 1 in 14 nationally. Wonders are chosen by published rules, such as national parks by visitor numbers and universities by R&D spending, etc etc.
- 19 lenses (income, degrees, faith, disasters…), a City View for 524 metros, and nine advisors plus an Explorer. The Explorer turns any column for any of 3,100+ counties into a table and scatter plot, linked to the map.
- Claude decided to skip a few states and territories sry
- Built using Claude Code desktop app, Opus 5.5 on medium and turning on ultracode.

It's deployed here: https://t.co/QMhmafXMj5 and the "?" has the source link too. I don't exactly know where I was going with this but it's really fun to browse and play with. Possibly it can be expanded or built into a game. I only have half of my weekly Claude quote left though so someone else will have to take over :D. Claude also made a trailer:

10月公開のdoda人事ジャーナルの連載「隣の気になる人事さん」で、Sakana AI Head of Peopleの橋本真帆（@m4h0）が、当社の採用の考え方についてお話ししました。研究と実装をつなぐ Applied Research Engineer （ARE）の選考を例に紹介しています。

橋本「（AREに求める力について）正解のない問いに向き合い、不確実な状況を楽しめることです。AIは常に進化しているので、今日の正解が明日には正解ではなくなっているかもしれません。そうした環境でも、自ら新しい技術を学び、考え、行動できる『自走力』を重視しています」

橋本「一つの職種の要件に完全に当てはまるかだけを見るのではなく、その人の強みをどこで最も活かせるのかを考えることも、マッチングでは大切だと思います」

note_tweet.text:
The Agentic Scientist: Paper talk now on YouTube!

In this talk, we argue that The Agentic Scientist creates a framework by which off-the-shelf coding agents can be used as research collaborators.

Solely relying on off-the-shelf coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, these agents tend to behave like strong hyperparameter optimizers when given a research question. While the scores improve, the ideas remain narrow and the reasons for gains are rarely examined.

The Agentic Scientist makes the research loop explicit by using a meta-controller to run parallel instances of agents over a sequence of tasks including task drafting, ideation, planning, sandboxed experiments with baselines and ablations, analysis, and writing. All steps are evaluated against rubrics defined upfront and prior to any experiments.

We showcase the results for an early version of The Agentic Scientist, which helped us study Error Diffusion, a biologically inspired alternative to backpropagation. The work was accepted as an oral at ALIFE 2026. In autonomous runs, the system raised Doc-to-LoRA multi-needle retrieval accuracy from 52% to 98% and designed a learned evolution strategy that improved over its CMA-ES reference on unseen tasks. We ablate the importance of different orchestration layers vs. the strength of base model, finding that reliable autonomy crucially depends on the latter.

Human researchers define the initial question and evidence standards, while agents extend the set of experiments that can be performed.

theres a lot of disingenuous/wishful thinking on “open catching up to closed” and more recently have heard that a few top open models are benchmaxxed (rank much lower on any private eval)

this pretrain pplx estimate probably better reflects reality at least from a pretrain perspective. 

the good news - open models eventually get there! only 1.5 year behind!

the bad news - best model rn is opus 4.1/gemini 2.5 tier. unusable by 2027 standard

posttraining is NOT to be ignored and in fact @jietang has been basically entirely investing in scaling posttraining for glm. but generally intelligent “big model smell” is probably best tracked by pplx

note_tweet.text:
声を出さず、唇もほとんど動かさずにAIへ話しかけられる装置が作られました。
奥歯に引っかけて使う、重さ4.5グラムのセンサーです。
研究者らが、国際会議UIST 2026で発表しました。

ユーザーは舌をわずかに動かし、口の中で息を流して話します。その振動が歯に伝わり、歯に密着したセンサーが検出します。信号はBluetoothでスマホやPCに送られ、音声認識AIのWhisperに小さな変換器を足したモデルが文に直します。

実験の結果↓

・座った状態では、50種類の命令文を91.5%の精度で認識
・70デシベルの騒音の中でも86.3%

※今回試された命令文は、Siriの公式ガイドにある「電気をつけて」のような2〜7語の文です。

ただし、現在の技術的課題として、まだ認識できるのは決まった50文で、ユーザーごとに5文を使った事前の調整が必要です。歩きながら使うと47.6%に落ちます。

なお、部品の費用は量産すれば1個13.4ドル、電池は連続で2時間もちます。設計は公開されています。
